acceptance_checks: scripts/shiki_migrations.py defines a dependency-free migration registry, migration state loading, status, pending, dry-run planning, and explicit execute-gated apply behavior.
.shiki/migrations/state.json is committed, required by the manifest, included in install/staging, and records baseline migration M-20260604-0001-baseline.
shiki migrate status/plan/apply expose machine-readable JSON and human output; apply is dry-run by default and requires --execute or --i-understand for mutation.
Destructive migrations require --i-understand even when execution is requested.
shiki doctor reports migration registry, migration state, and pending migration findings without applying migrations.
scripts/validate_shiki.py validates migration registry IDs, dependencies, state JSON, applied records, baseline application, manifest coverage, and migration docs.
scripts/test_shiki_migrations.sh covers registry, state validation, CLI status/plan/apply, dry-run/execute/idempotence, destructive policy, doctor integration, and manifest staging.
docs/agents/shiki-migrations.md and related agent docs describe migration state path, baseline, dry-run / execute behavior, destructive policy, doctor, validator, and GitHub source-of-truth relation.
Verification bundle passes: validate_shiki, py_compile, scripts/test_shiki_*.sh, migrate status JSON, migrate plan, migrate apply dry-run, and git diff --check.
non_goals: Do not implement P1.4 governance or evidence model redesign.
Do not implement P2 packaging, release, or onboarding work.
Do not implement a new runtime adapter execution engine.
Do not add new GitHub provider support.
Do not change CCA Review Bridge semantics.
Do not change branch protection or CODEOWNERS.
Do not change P0.4 state, lock, ledger, or evidence semantics.
Do not add an external database or external migration service.
Do not broadly rewrite historical .shiki state.
Do not automatically migrate on every command without explicit user intent.
scope: Add a dependency-free migration framework for repository-local .shiki state changes with deterministic registry, baseline migration state, dry-run planning, explicit execute-gated apply behavior, doctor readiness findings, validator coverage, manifest/staging integration, tests, and documentation.
title: Add .shiki migration framework
